description: The trader type is taken from the trader who made the snapshot's transaction (`transactionrecord.trdref`).

a.request: Take the sentiment snapshots in `sentimentandfundamentals` that match their transaction (`transref`), and attach the trader type of the trader who made that transaction (`transactionrecord.trdref`), dropping anything without a match. For each pair of transaction (`transref`) and trader type, average the analyst coverage count (`anlycount`), ignoring missing values. Keep the pairs whose average is above the overall mean of those pair averages, and note how far above it they are. Then for each trader type, return the trader type, the average analyst count of its kept pairs, their average amount above the overall mean, and that trader type's average analyst count divided by the mean of this figure across all trader types, without rounding.
a.sql: WITH sentiment_transaction_trader AS (SELECT s.transref, s.anlycount, t.tradekind FROM sentimentandfundamentals s INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON s.transref = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg), pair_averages AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(anlycount) as avg_anlycount FROM sentiment_transaction_trader WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY transref, tradekind), overall_mean_value AS (SELECT AVG(avg_anlycount) as overall_mean FROM pair_averages), kept_pairs AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_anlycount, avg_anlycount - (SELECT overall_mean FROM overall_mean_value) as above_mean FROM pair_averages WHERE avg_anlycount > (SELECT overall_mean FROM overall_mean_value)), trader_type_stats AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_anlycount) as avg_analyst_count, AVG(above_mean) as avg_above_mean FROM kept_pairs GROUP BY tradekind), mean_above_all_traders AS (SELECT AVG(avg_above_mean) as mean_above_all FROM trader_type_stats) SELECT tts.tradekind, tts.avg_analyst_count, tts.avg_above_mean, tts.avg_analyst_count / maat.mean_above_all as ratio FROM trader_type_stats tts CROSS JOIN mean_above_all_traders maat;

b.request: Calculate mean anlycount for each (transref, trader type from transactionrecord.trdref) pair, filter to pairs exceeding the overall mean, then per trader type report the trader type, mean anlycount of its kept pairs, average margin over overall mean, and its kept-pair mean anlycount divided by the cross-trader-type mean anlycount.
b.sql:
WITH pair_means AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.transref,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(sf.anlycount) as pair_mean_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY sf.transref, t.tradekind
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(sf.anlycount) as overall_mean_anlycount
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
),
kept_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pm.transref,
    pm.tradekind,
    pm.pair_mean_anlycount
  FROM pair_means pm
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE pm.pair_mean_anlycount > om.overall_mean_anlycount
),
trader_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    kp.tradekind,
    AVG(kp.pair_mean_anlycount) as mean_anlycount_of_kept_pairs,
    (SELECT overall_mean_anlycount FROM overall_mean) as overall_mean,
    (SELECT AVG(pair_mean_anlycount) FROM kept_pairs) as cross_trader_mean
  FROM kept_pairs kp
  GROUP BY kp.tradekind
)
SELECT 
  tradekind as trader_type,
  mean_anlycount_of_kept_pairs,
  mean_anlycount_of_kept_pairs - overall_mean as average_margin_over_overall_mean,
  mean_anlycount_of_kept_pairs / cross_trader_mean as ratio
FROM trader_type_stats
ORDER BY tradekind
b.raw: Calculate mean anlycount for each (transref, trader type from transactionrecord.trdref) pair, filter to pairs exceeding the overall mean, then per trader type report the trader type, mean anlycount of its kept pairs, average margin over overall mean, and its kept-pair mean anlycount divided by the cross-trader-type mean anlycount.

c.request: For the sentiment snapshots in `sentimentandfundamentals` that match their transaction (`transref`), look at the snapshot's trader type (skipping anything without a match). For each transaction (`transref`) and trader type pair, average the analyst coverage count (`anlycount`), ignoring missing values, and keep the pairs above the overall mean of those pair averages, noting by how much. Then per trader type, give the trader type, the average analyst count of its kept pairs, their average margin over the overall mean, and that average analyst count relative to (divided by) the mean of it across trader types — unrounded. The trader type is taken from the trader who made the snapshot's transaction (`transactionrecord.trdref`).
c.sql:
WITH pair_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.transref,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(sf.anlycount) as pair_avg_analyst
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY sf.transref, t.tradekind
),
overall_mean_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(pair_avg_analyst) as overall_mean
  FROM pair_stats
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.transref,
    ps.tradekind,
    ps.pair_avg_analyst,
    ps.pair_avg_analyst - omc.overall_mean as margin
  FROM pair_stats ps, overall_mean_calc omc
  WHERE ps.pair_avg_analyst > omc.overall_mean
),
trader_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    fp.tradekind,
    AVG(fp.pair_avg_analyst) as avg_analyst_count,
    AVG(fp.margin) as avg_margin
  FROM filtered_pairs fp
  GROUP BY fp.tradekind
),
trader_mean_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_analyst_count) as mean_across_types
  FROM trader_stats
)
SELECT 
  ts.tradekind as trader_type,
  ts.avg_analyst_count,
  ts.avg_margin,
  ts.avg_analyst_count / tmc.mean_across_types as relative_to_mean
FROM trader_stats ts, trader_mean_calc tmc
ORDER BY ts.tradekind;

d.request: For sentiment snapshots with matching transactions, obtain the trader type from the trader who made that transaction (via transactionrecord.trdref), group by transaction and trader type, compute average analyst coverage per group ignoring nulls, filter groups exceeding the overall mean of group averages, and report per trader type: the type, the average analyst count of kept groups, their average margin over the overall mean, and that average analyst count divided by the mean analyst count across all trader types.
d.sql:
WITH group_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    t.transreg,
    tr.tradekind,
    AVG(s.anlycount) as avg_analyst
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
  WHERE s.anlycount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.transreg, tr.tradekind
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_analyst) as overall_avg
  FROM group_avgs
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT ga.tradekind, ga.avg_analyst
  FROM group_avgs ga, overall_mean om
  WHERE ga.avg_analyst > om.overall_avg
),
by_type AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(avg_analyst) as avg_count
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
type_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_count) as mean_across_types
  FROM by_type
)
SELECT 
  bt.tradekind,
  bt.avg_count,
  bt.avg_count - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_mean) as margin_over_mean,
  bt.avg_count / (SELECT mean_across_types FROM type_mean) as ratio_to_mean
FROM by_type bt
ORDER BY tradekind;
